results.question: Scope of work
results.answer:
• Walls: Brick Masonry

• Painting work: Internal emulsion Paint, External Weathershield paint
• Tile works: Granite for doors & window sills & Jams, Vitrified tiles flooring and skirting, dado for rooms, & ceramic tiles flooring and skirting, dado for toilet
• Doors, Windows and ventilators: Granite stone cladding frame, Single shutter solid core Flush door, FRP door for toilet, Partition Work, Aluminum sliding two/three track windows & ventilator as per plan

• Other Items: R.C.C. water tank at ground level & Sintex water tank at terrace level, C.C Road work, Paver Block in parking area

results.question: Minimum value of work to be executed interim RA payment
R.A Bill Payments
results.answer:
• Security Deposit Deduction: Remaining 8% (out of total 10% Security Deposit) will be deducted from every running bill.
• Tax Deductions: Income Tax @ 2% or percentage in force from time to time shall be deducted from bill amounts whether measured bill, advance payment, or secured advance.
• Labour Welfare Cess: Cess @ 1% (One Percent) shall be deducted at source from every bill under Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Cess Act 1996.
• Royalty Deduction: Royalty charges will be recovered from contractor's bills if valid payment proof for material consumption is not produced.
• GST Compensation: Extra burden of GST, if any, shall be compensated upon production of authenticated records of net extra burden on account of GST.
results.source: 1 FORM.pdf, Page 4; Page 15, Clause 1.4; Page 31, Clause 1.14 b, Clause 1.27 & Clause 1.30

results.question: Performance Security
results.answer:
Additional Performance Security Deposit (if offer quoted is below estimated cost):
• 1% to 10% Below: 1%
• 10% to 15% Below: 5% (Total 6%)
• More than 15% Below: 1% + 5% + double rate of the percentage by which offer is more than 15% below (e.g., for 19% below: 1% + 5% + 8% = 14%)
• Submission Period: Must be submitted in the form of DD of a Nationalized/Scheduled Bank within 8 days from the date of opening of financial bid.
results.source: Document: 1 FORM.pdf, Page 9-10, Clause 5 & 6 & Page 28, Clause 1
